title: Australian National Database of Spoken Language

version.label: collection record as published on Research Data Australia

citation: Millar, J. Bruce et al. The Australian National Database of Spoken Language. Research Data Australia collection record 124997.

governance.retention_or_deletion_duties: Do not acquire, retain, upload or process source data while the recorded rights state blocks use.

population.description: Australian English recordings with phonetic, phonemic and word level annotation across documented Australian accent groups.
limitations: The published rights statement permits private research and study only, so commercial product engineering is prohibited.
No distribution host serves the collection any more, so there is no acquisition route even if the rights changed.
An accent group label describes a speaker and never licenses a judgement about one.

annotation.provenance: No annotations acquired; the public collection record was read.
limitations: No source record may enter engineering while access or rights remain blocked.

inspected_materials: Research Data Australia collection record 124997, read 2026-07-29.
Domain name and HTTP reachability of the former ANDOSL host, checked 2026-07-29.
findings: The rights statement reserves all rights and permits private research and study only, with any other use requiring permission. Commercial use is prohibited.
Intellectual property is owned by Macquarie University and the collection is managed by Associate Professor Steve Cassidy.

andosl.anu.edu.au still carries a domain name alias chain to an Australian National University address, but nothing answers on port 80 or 443. The earlier record that it no longer resolves was imprecise; the conclusion that it is unreachable holds.
The owner declined acquisition enquiries on 2026-07-28, so the permission route is closed by decision as well as by licence.

participant_split.source_split_provenance: No source participant data is acquired or approved.

lineage.duplicate_detection: Required if rights later permit acquisition.
